# Example Quest Decompilation — Project Context & Roadmap

> **Version:** 1.0.0
> **Generated:** 2026-06-10
> **Generation:** Gen1 | **Tech Stack:** PS1 matching decomp — WSL2 Ubuntu: Ghidra + MCP, splat + GCC 2.7.2 cc1 + maspsx + mipsel binutils

## Project Overview

A matching decompilation of the PS1 game Example Quest, targeting byte-identical binaries from hand-written C source.

## Architecture

The build uses splat for ROM splitting, GCC 2.7.2-era cc1 for compilation, and maspsx for assembler compatibility.
